title: Relax normalized Gaussian forward accuracy by 2Gamma bits (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. In CubeJerry's [#6993](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6993) normalized Gaussian convolution channel, each forward transform may request exactly `2Gamma` fewer accuracy bits. The opposite-transform tolerance, common q grid, actual-input radius guards and final strict integer-recovery error `<1/4` are preserved under the stated source contracts.

```text
a = 2ceil(log2 S)+2b+7, 1 <= S < 2^b
forward stage requests: tau = a+2
opposite stage requests: tau = a+2Gamma+2
common grid: q >= a+3Gamma+7, plus actual source/ledger guards
```

The new step is the asymmetric error allocation, produced by Nick Petalas. It permits forward map error `2^(-a-Gamma)` in place of `2^(-a-3Gamma)`. The exact normalized identity, physical endpoints and classical product perturbation inequality are credited prior work. Credit Jerry Chen / CubeJerry #6993, Cinna Davis #4100, Ryanson Jonathan #4320/#4415 and the retained native/scalar/Fourier/source lineage. No predecessor scientific suite was replayed as the deliverable.

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; contribution head `ab0171aa937f4f84b8af2d29234a385c2200416a`. The `supplier-boundary-audit` card changes scope to an original analytic interface improvement. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542470). The proof and exact provenance are in `research/asymmetric-gaussian-precision/`.

## Evidence

- Before: the predecessor assigns `tau=a+2Gamma+2` to every stage of all three calls. After: the two forward calls use `tau=a+2`, with final error bounded by `(777/512)2^-a` after removing the three Gaussian normalizers. Restoring the unchanged S-squared digit scale gives error strictly below `1/4`.
- Local CPython 3.12.15 normal and optimized checks pass 315 budget cases, 1,152 literal inward-rounded convolution executions, six abstract scalar equalities and ten controls. Their generated six-file hash-bound receipts agree. Length-2/4 fixtures illustrate the norm contract; they are not production odd-source transforms.
- Both registered checks pass. Each direct check took 0.17 seconds locally; these are validation durations, not a runtime improvement. Each registered timeout is 120 seconds.
- Metadata/pins, source compilation, bounded-function inspection, exact committed bytes/modes and source-history preflight pass. Official six-file export integrity and a read-only, empty-PATH, Git-free optimized exported replay pass with the same receipt.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/asymmetric-gaussian-precision
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -B research/asymmetric-gaussian-precision/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -O -B research/asymmetric-gaussian-precision/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/asymmetric-gaussian-precision --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another CPython 3.12 installation can replace the absolute interpreter path. Standard library only. Expected verifier marker: `PASS_ASYMMETRIC_GAUSSIAN_PRECISION`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The theorem is a conditional error-budget improvement. A fixed common q or another applicability guard can prevent a physical width reduction. Separately prepared forward sources, references and phase banks must satisfy their actual finite gates. No production controller, complete physical price, storage/runtime improvement, supplier admission, new kappa, complete multiplication theorem or selected-frontier change is claimed. Original-coordinate extraction, CRT, carry/output and all five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Prepare one actual forward controller at these requests and determine whether a binding physical width decreases after every reference/source gate and complete cost is included.
- Fund all conversion errors in a separately admitted pointwise precision schedule before attempting to lower common q. The opposite-transform error budget remains necessary.

## Related open work

The completion check read this account's ten open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including this one. None of the nine others studies the same normalized-convolution accuracy quantity or computes a competing tolerance.

- [#7263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7263) constructs exact norm-one Gaussian-rational Stein factorizations. Its coefficient-factorization norm question is separate from this transform-error allocation; neither result supplies the other's physical caller.
- [#7268](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7268) reduces compact rounded-ADD residue control. Its finite-control cost reduction does not alter this proof's retained pointwise truncation or transform-error budgets. No additional numerical comparison was run.

#6993 is merged and supplies the predecessor normalized-channel interface; it is not an admission of the production caller.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `ab0171aa937f4f84b8af2d29234a385c2200416a`, [run 43030135179, plan job 130554753063](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43030135179/job/130554753063) failed in `Onboarding helper tests` on exactly `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`. The job reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skips. Its AssertionError states that ``'`make frontier7000-verify`'`` was not found in the current CI verification section, which still describes #6030.

I inspected that job log and the unchanged base files at `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` selects `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still names `make frontier6030-verify`. This PR changes only its six package files. The `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed; no hosted package verification ran.

I also directly inspected [run 42905094314, job 130140894651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314/job/130140894651) and [run 43029125610, job 130551298799](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029125610/job/130551298799). Each reports the same failing test, the same missing-command AssertionError, and exactly one failure among 760 tests with 24 skips. These are the other runs verified here; no broader CI claim is made.

The local normal/optimized registered checks and export checks reported above passed. The branch is unchanged; no unrelated repair, retrigger commit or job rerun was made.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. This adds one isolated research package.

**Blast Radius:** package. The selected frontier and predecessor packages are unchanged.
